fields.note: Season is complete (Kauno Žalgiris champions); the lt.wikipedia season article gives the last day of play as 8 November 2026, replacing the year-only 'November 2026' in the asset note.

LTU2 carries LI1's (TOPLYGA) window via 'inherited_from', but it is a different competition: LFF I lyga 2026. Its own 2026 article gives only the month ('2026 m. kovas – lapkritis', title decided by 'golden matches' in mid-November), so no day exists for 2026-27; the value is a proxy from the same league's 2025 season, which ended on 9 November 2025 and matches that mid-November statement. The inherited 11-29 (a TOPLYGA default) is wrong for this league.
